name: Boyd ROL4000-48U65 in-row CDU
description: 2 MW in-row liquid-to-liquid CDU built to Google's Project Deschutes 5 spec style: 80 psi available pressure, N+1 seal-less pumps, redundant power feeds per pump circuit. Large: 1651 W x 1016 D x 2629 H mm.

capacity_w.note: 2000 kW at 3 C ATD with N+1 pumps (more with all pumps running); secondary sized with 25% PG, primary water; supply temperatures not stated

max_flow_kg_s.note: nominal secondary flow 500 GPM (1893 L/min) at 80 psi; 1893 * 0.998 / 60 = 31.49 kg/s

pump_head_kpa.note: 80 psi (5.5 bar) available at 500 GPM; 80 * 6.895 = 551.6 kPa

power_w.note: not published. Floor: hydraulic power 0.03155 m3/s * (552 + ~100 kPa) = 20.6 kW / 0.7 = 29 kW. Ceiling: listed input ~140 A total at 415 V 3-phase = sqrt(3)*415*140 = 100.6 kVA

weight_kg.note: ~4750 lb DRY; operating weight not published

filtration_um.note: 25 um secondary/TCS, 500 um primary with bypass

sources.title: Boyd Coolant Distribution Units performance specifications (CDU comparison)
